sgp.qualifiers: Kawhi (F, usage ~33% CraftedNBA, season unlabeled) vs CHI forwards 1st-most allowed; Barrett (G, 26.0%) vs CHI guards 6th. Failed: Barnes 23.4% (usage), Giddey 24.4% and Powell 27.2% vs TOR G 21st/F 22nd, Quickley 21.1%.
sgp.note: No SGP or alt prices were published; implied (~-300) is the product of alt prices estimated from the main lines, so the edge cannot be shown.

research:
Lines: SI/DraftKings TOR -9.5 (-110), total 236.5, ML TOR -425 / CHI +330; WagerTalk TOR -9.5 (-115), 236.5; Action Network/Scores&Stats DK opener -8.5, 235.5, TOR -345/CHI +275; Capper's Picks 236.5; Bleacher Report TOR -9.5. The line moved toward Toronto.
Experts: WagerTalk TOR -9.5 and Under 236.5 (120-109); SI and SportsGambler TOR -9.5; Dimers model TOR 73%, 121-114, value on CHI +9.5 (+101 Kalshi, 55.4%); ATS.io Under 235.5 (119-112); Picks and Parlays wary of TOR laying 9.
Injuries: CHI Nic Claxton out (hamstring, Splitter says 'out a while'); Awaka, Collins, L. Miller, Okoro probable (Heavy). TOR: Quickley rested Oct 16 but expected to start (Fox Sports); Nate Bittle out (WagerTalk); Kawhi expected to play.
Roster changes: TOR traded Ingram, Gradey Dick and picks to LAC for Kawhi Leonard (official Sept 14). Starters are Quickley, Barrett, Leonard, Barnes, Poeltl, and Kawhi is targeted for ~32 min. Center depth behind Poeltl is thin (Raptors Republic, Yahoo).
CHI: new coach Tiago Splitter and GM Bryson Graham. Projected starters Giddey, Powell (signed after an All-Star year in MIA), Buzelis, rookie Caleb Wilson (No. 4 pick), and Claxton (out). Bench: Hield, Tre Jones, Collins, Swain (NBA.com, Yahoo).
2025-26: TOR 46-36, swept CHI 3-0, lost a seven-game first-round series to CLE; CHI 31-51, allowed 121.5 ppg (StatMuse).
Usage (2025-26, opening night so last season is used): Powell 27.2% (Screwball), Barrett 26.0% (Screwball), Giddey 24.4% (StatMuse), Barnes 23.4%, Quickley 21.1% (StatMuse). Kawhi's usage was not confirmed on B-Ref; CraftedNBA lists 33.5% (season unlabeled) on 27.9 ppg.
DvP (Legion Report, 2025-26 DK pts allowed, rank 1 = most): CHI G 6th, F 1st, C 13th; TOR G 21st, F 22nd, C 23rd. Kawhi and Barrett pass; no Bulls player does. RotoGrinders (undated) has CHI SF 14th and SG 19th, so the gate is source-dependent.
SGP 93% lines (normal approx; game logs not reachable): Kawhi 15+ pts ~0.94, 3+ reb ~0.93; Barrett 10+ pts ~0.90 after cutting his role for Kawhi. Raw product 0.79, shrunk to 0.74 for role change and correlation. Estimated alt prices imply ~0.75 (about -300), so there is no edge and no highlight.
Assists legs were dropped (lesson), and TOR allowed the 2nd-fewest assists in 2025-26 (SportsGambler).
Totals (USU MACFAX adjusted for TOR: 113.6/112.4, pace 101.5; CHI derived from StatMuse 116.3/121.5 ppg at 102.53 pace = 113.4/118.5): avg poss 102.0; TOR 118.4, CHI 115.2, total 233.6 vs 236.5 (2.9 under, below the 4-pt trigger, so it's a lean). Margin TOR +3.2 plus ~2 home court = ~5, below the 9.5 spread.
Caveat: the 2025-26 TOR numbers have Ingram, not Kawhi, which likely understates Toronto. Powell and Wilson are new to Chicago, and Claxton's absence hurts its rim defense.
Props seen: Kawhi pts 24.5 (ESPN o-125/u-102; SportsGambler -118/-118), reb 6.5 (o-100/u-135), ast 3.5 (o+120/u-167); Barrett pts 18.5 (Bleacher Nation), 16.5 (SportsMole); Barnes 18.5 pts, o5.5 ast -141; Giddey pts 14.5 (-114/-120), ast u9.5 -133 (SI).
Kawhi preseason: 2 GP, 13.5 ppg and 3.0 rpg in limited minutes, so a minutes cap is the main risk to his overs.
Coaching: Darko Rajakovic keeps a 9-10 man rotation; Splitter is new, and the rotation is unsettled with Claxton out (Collins/Awaka at C).
Sources were unreachable directly (ESPN, Action Network, Covers blocked); figures come from search-result snippets. Team notes files for CHI/TOR do not exist.
